order: A then B; each uses the existing query order Q001..Q020,one generation each,serially. No warmup or randomized order.
isolation: one new Node process per model load; CPU session intra/interOpNumThreads1; no CPU affinity,isolated cores or controlled filesystem cache
generation: use frozen plan values without sampling or favorable retries; preserve generated IDs,full decode and standard special-token-skipping decode
journal: record case started before executing; write one exclusive result. Resume only never-started cases; a started case without a saved result is classified interrupted_unknown,never regenerated. Loading again for remaining cases is recorded as a new session.
loadFailure: save profile load error and mark not-executed cases,continue other profile; this does not count as model comparison success

timing.clock: performance.now monotonic milliseconds within one process
timing.modelLoadMs: local AutoModelForCausalLM loading,after verification; not file download or total process startup
timing.prepareInputMs: re-tokenize saved prompt into model tensors and assert exact IDs
timing.generateMs: whole model.generate call,includes prefill and autoregressive decoding; first request may initialize kernels
timing.decodeMs: both output text decodes after generate returns
timing.caseTotalMs: prepare+generate+decode+technical validation,excludes disk result writes,retrieval,context packing,semantic review,download and model load
timing.tokens: all produced token IDs including EOS/special IDs; raw content may contain fewer visible tokens
timing.cpu: process.resourceUsage user/system CPU microsecond deltas around generate; includes all process work in that interval
timing.memory: process.memoryUsage RSS samples before/after generate in bytes,not a peak or model-only memory
timing.limits: no TTFT/streaming/network RAG latency,cloud bill or causal speed superiority. Twenty authored queries per profile,not a production percentile benchmark.

validationAndEvaluation: strict schema and preregistered editorial semantic rubric; no gold enters input tensors; original corpus,queries and gold unchanged
